sn38.3:1.1: Ke nu kho āvuso Sāriputta loke dhammānuvādino || ke loke suppaṭipannā || ke loke sugatā ti || || 4
sn38.3:1.2: Ye kho āvuso loke rāgappahānāya dhammaṃ desenti dosappahānāya dhammaṃ desenti mohappahānāya dhammam desenti || te loke dhammavādino || || 5
sn38.3:1.3: Ye kho āvuso rāgassa pahānāya paṭipannā || dosassa || pe || mohassa pahānāya paṭipannā || te loke suppaṭipannā || || 6
sn38.3:1.4: Yesam kho āvuso rāgo pahīno ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvakato āyatim anuppādadhammo || doso pahīno ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvakato āyatim anuppādadhammo || moho pahīno ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvakato āyatim anuppādadhammo || te loke sugatā ti || || 7
sn38.3:2.1: Atthi panāvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa rāgassa dosassa mohassa pahānāyāti || ||
sn38.3:2.2: Atthi kho āvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa rāgassa dosassa mohassa pahānāyāti || || 8
sn38.3:2.3: Katamo panāvuso maggo katamā paṭipadā etassa rāgassa dosassa mohassa pahānāyāti || ||
sn38.3:2.4: Ayam eva kho āvuso ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo etassa rāgassa dosassa mohassa pahānāya || seyyathīdaṃ
sn38.3:2.6: Ayam kho āvuso maggo ayam paṭipadā etassa rāgassa dosassa mohassa pahānāyāti || || 9
sn38.3:2.7: Bhaddako āvuso maggo bhaddikā paṭipadā etassa rāgassa dosassa mohassa pahānāya ||
